## Hello Work fixture glossary

These sanitized fixtures preserve the public Hello Work labels the parser relies on.
They remove personal contact details and replace employer-specific text with generic examples.

- `job-fulltime.html`
  - Public employer listing (`公開範囲 １`).
  - Full-time role with visible company, monthly wage range, payment timing, working hours, overtime, holidays, and required experience.
  - Includes a Japanese-language requirement inside `求人に関する特記事項`.

- `job-anonymous-employer.html`
  - Restricted employer visibility example (`公開範囲 ２`).
  - Preserves the public notice shown when employer details are limited to registered Hello Work job seekers.

- `job-online-self-application.html`
  - Online self-application example (`オンライン自主応募の受付 可`).
  - Preserves the distinction between direct self-application and ordinary Hello Work introduction/manual contact.
